image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a blue speckled ceramic plate containing a dessert. The dish features several segments of cooked fruit (likely poached peaches or apricots) with a glossy orange glaze, accompanied by two scoops of pale yellow/cream-colored ice cream. The ice cream shows signs of melting and mixing with the fruit syrup. There are small dark flecks visible within the ice cream, possibly vanilla bean or spices.
